intro: Tajikistan is the poorest of the former Soviet republics and relies heavily on money sent home from Russia.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Remittances are among the highest in the world compared to the size of the economy. Aluminium, cotton and hydropower are the main products.

chapters.title: Hydropower
text: Mountain rivers produce almost all electricity, and Tajikistan hopes to sell power to neighbours.

cardGroups.title: Made in Tajikistan
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Tajikistan makes and sells to the world.
